title: Elon Musk
author: Ashlee Vance
summary: An early authorized biography tracing Elon Musk from childhood in South Africa through PayPal to the risky founding and survival of Tesla and SpaceX.
readIf: you are curious how a founder bet everything on electric cars and rockets.
skipIf: you want an up-to-date picture, since the book stops around 2015.
